title: Hereditary chamber
html_source:
The House of Lords is the upper house of the Parliament of the United Kingdom. Membership was once an entitlement of all hereditary peers, other than those in the peerage of Ireland, but under the House of Lords Act 1999, the right to membership was restricted to 92 hereditary peers.
